mapper.select: select task_id, task_name, status, source_id, wiki_space_id from analysis_task where task_id = #{taskId} for update
select * from ontology_analysis_job where task_id = #{taskId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into ontology_analysis_job (task_id, run_token, status, stage, request_json, checkpoint_json, username, message, lease_until, model_calls, created_at, updated_at) values (#{taskId}, #{runToken}, 'RUNNING', #{stage}, #{requestJson}, #{checkpointJson}, #{username}, #{message}, #{leaseUntil}, 0, current_timestamp, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update ontology_analysis_job set run_token = #{runToken}, status = 'RUNNING', stage = #{stage}, request_json = #{requestJson}, checkpoint_json = #{checkpointJson}, username = #{username}, message = #{message}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, model_calls = 0, proposal_id = null, updated_at = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into ontology_analysis_run (task_id, run_token, run_kind, source_id, wiki_space_id, selection_json, username, started_at, status, stage) values (#{taskId}, #{runToken}, #{runKind}, #{sourceId}, #{wikiSpaceId}, #{selectionJson}, #{username}, #{startedAt}, 'RUNNING', #{stage})

insert into ontology_analysis_model_call (task_id, run_token, call_number, stage, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, status, failure_type) values (#{taskId}, #{runToken}, #{callNumber}, #{stage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMillis}, #{status}, #{failureType})

insert into ontology_analysis_stage_timing (task_id, run_token, stage, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, status, failure_type) values (#{taskId}, #{runToken}, #{stage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMillis}, #{status}, #{failureType})
mapper.select: select r.run_id, r.run_token, r.run_kind, r.source_id, r.wiki_space_id, r.selection_json, r.username, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.status, r.stage, r.model_calls, r.proposal_id from ontology_analysis_run r where r.task_id = #{taskId} and r.run_id = #{runId}

select s.timing_id, s.stage, s.started_at, s.finished_at, s.duration_ms, s.status, s.failure_type from ontology_analysis_stage_timing s join ontology_analysis_run r on r.task_id = s.task_id and r.run_token = s.run_token join analysis_task t on t.task_id = r.task_id where s.task_id = #{taskId} and r.run_id = #{runId} order by s.timing_id

select c.call_id, c.call_number, c.stage, c.started_at, c.finished_at, c.duration_ms, c.status, c.failure_type from ontology_analysis_model_call c join ontology_analysis_run r on r.task_id = c.task_id and r.run_token = c.run_token where c.task_id = #{taskId} and r.run_id = #{runId} order by c.call_number limit 100
mapper.update: update ontology_analysis_job set status = #{status}, message = #{message}, proposal_id = #{proposalId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId} and run_token = #{runToken} and status = 'RUNNING'
update analysis_task set status = #{status}, summary = #{message}, update_by = #{username}, update_time = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId}
